lead.en: Show a sentence as a short sequence of rising words.
lead.zh: 逐词展示一句文字。

rule.en: Set a delay or replay with new text.
rule.zh: 可设置延时，替换文字可重新播放。

api.en: Set a delay or replay with new text.
api.zh: 可设置延时，替换文字可重新播放。

motion.en: Words rise with a capped stagger; reduced motion shows the text immediately.
motion.zh: 词语依次升起，整体错峰时长受限；减少动效时直接显示。

lead.en: Reveal a heading when at least 45% is visible.
lead.zh: 标题至少 45% 进入窗口时展示。

rule.en: Use once for a one-time entrance, or disable it to replay.
rule.zh: 可设置仅出现一次，也可在移出后重新展示。

api.en: Use once for a one-time entrance, or disable it to replay.
api.zh: 可设置仅出现一次，也可在移出后重新展示。

motion.en: The title rises and fades in; reduced motion displays it immediately.
motion.zh: 标题上移淡入；减少动效时立即显示。

lead.en: Transition a short changing label while matching repeated characters by occurrence.
lead.zh: 按字符出现次序匹配，让短文案平滑切换。

rule.en: Call set_text with the next label; the width follows measured text.
rule.zh: 调用 set_text 更新文案，宽度根据实际字形测量并变化。

api.en: Call set_text with the next label; the width follows measured text.
api.zh: 调用 set_text 更新文案，宽度根据实际字形测量并变化。

motion.en: Matched glyph positions and width use interruptible springs; reduced motion swaps immediately.
motion.zh: 匹配文字与容器宽度使用可中断弹簧；减少动效时立即切换。

lead.en: Show a soft highlight sweeping over an active status label.
lead.zh: 在进行中的状态文字上扫过柔和高光。

rule.en: Pause with set_active or set_visible; defaults to a 1.8 second sweep.
rule.zh: 用 set_active 或 set_visible 暂停；默认扫过时长 1.8 秒。

api.en: set_active and set_visible control playback. with_duration defaults to 1.8s; with_font_size defaults to 16px with a 2.2em band. with_active(false) starts as steady text without a settling animation.
api.zh: set_active / set_visible 控制播放；with_duration 默认1.8s，with_font_size 默认16px，微光带按2.2em计算。with_active(false) 从静态文字开始，不播放停用过渡。

motion.en: The highlight passes across the label; reduced motion shows steady text.
motion.zh: 高光扫过文字；减少动效时显示静态文字。

lead.en: Animate changes to a short numeric value with rolling digit cells.
lead.zh: 用滚动数字展示短数值的变化。

rule.en: Change text with set_value; digits align from the right.
rule.zh: 通过 set_value 更新，数字从右侧匹配。

api.en: Change text with set_value; digits align from the right.
api.zh: 通过 set_value 更新，数字从右侧匹配。

motion.en: Digit reels roll and settle with stagger; reduced motion jumps to the target.
motion.zh: 数字逐列滚动并依次停下；减少动效时立即展示目标。

lead.en: Type to press sculpted keycaps and light the board.
lead.zh: 输入或点击，让机械键帽下沉并亮起。

rule.en: Focus the readout to type or activate a cap. Tab navigates, and on-screen Shift applies to the next character.
rule.zh: 聚焦读数区即可键入，也可点击键帽。Tab 移焦，屏幕上的 Shift 作用于下一个字符。

api.en: Choose a preset or custom rows, listen in focus or window mode, and read the retained graphemes.
api.zh: 可选预设或自定义行，支持焦点和窗口监听，以及按字素保留文字。

motion.en: Keycaps sink on press, lift on release, and leave a fading light. Reduced motion keeps the light response.
motion.zh: 键帽按下下沉，松手回弹并留下余光。减少动效时保留亮光反馈。

lead.en: Play a terminal transcript with typed commands and a seekable timeline.
lead.zh: 播放带逐字输入、命令输出和可拖动时间轴的终端会话。

rule.en: Drag the timeline to scrub. Arrow keys jump between commands. Space toggles playback.
rule.zh: 拖动时间轴定位，方向键跳转命令，空格播放或暂停。

api.en: Compose the session from typed commands, output, progress, and tasks. Copy collects the commands in order.
api.zh: 用命令、输出、进度和任务组成会话。复制会按顺序收集所有命令。

motion.en: Seeded typing and reversible seeking share one clock. Reduced motion starts at the completed transcript.
motion.zh: 逐字输入与可逆拖动共用时间轴。减少动效时直接显示完成态。

lead.en: Draw a pointer lens and click ripples behind interactive content.
lead.zh: 让光标推开点阵，并在点击处向外扩散涟漪。

rule.en: Use a pointer or tap to interact with the field. The density buttons keep their regular focus and click behavior.
rule.zh: 移动光标或点按画布即可互动，密度按钮保留正常的焦点与点击行为。

api.en: Configure spacing, dot size, lens radius, strength, colors, edge fade and ripples. Overlay regular GPUI content with with_content.
api.zh: 可配置间距、点半径、透镜范围、力度、配色、边缘淡出和涟漪。使用 with_content 添加普通 GPUI 内容。

motion.en: Each dot settles on a damped spring. Reduced motion tints the field without moving dots or emitting ripples.
motion.zh: 每个点通过阻尼弹簧回位。减少动效时，只保留点阵颜色反馈。

lead.en: Compare two images using a movable divider.
lead.zh: 拖动分隔线对比两张图片。

rule.en: Drag the divider, or use arrows, Home and End. Shift changes in larger steps.
rule.zh: 拖动分隔线，或用方向键、Home 和 End 调整；按住 Shift 使用更大步长。

api.en: Position is a fraction from 0 to 1; images are supplied by the host.
api.zh: 位置为 0 至 1 的比例；图片由宿主提供。

motion.en: Keyboard and host updates settle with a spring; pointer and touch track input.
motion.zh: 键盘和宿主更新使用弹簧；鼠标和触控位置直接跟随输入。

lead.en: Navigate a collection of images by dragging or using controls.
lead.zh: 通过拖动或导航控件浏览图片。

rule.en: Drag horizontally or use the arrow keys, Home, End and navigation buttons.
rule.zh: 可横向拖动，也可使用方向键、Home、End 和导航按钮。

api.en: Supply images and labels as CarouselSlide values; with_action_labels localizes navigation.
api.zh: 通过 CarouselSlide 提供图片和标签；with_action_labels 设置导航文案。

motion.en: Dragging follows the pointer; release settles to a slide using a spring. Reduced motion changes immediately.
motion.zh: 拖动时跟随指针，松手后以弹簧停靠；减少动效时立即切换。

lead.en: Review a sequence of cards and choose or skip each.
lead.zh: 逐张浏览卡片并选择或跳过。

rule.en: Drag a card or use left and right arrow keys; Backspace undoes the last decision.
rule.zh: 拖动卡片或用左右方向键选择；Backspace 撤销上一次选择。

api.en: StackDecision includes the card ID and decision. Undo emits StackUndo so the host can reverse its own change.
api.zh: StackDecision 包含卡片 ID 和选择；撤销时发出 StackUndo，宿主负责撤回自身数据。

motion.en: The decided card exits to the side; an uncommitted drag springs back. Reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 确认后卡片向侧面离开；未确认的拖动弹回。减少动效时立即更新。

lead.en: Show a host-controlled collection of transient notifications.
lead.zh: 展示由宿主控制的多条临时通知。

rule.en: Push, update or dismiss notifications by ID. Hover pauses each timer.
rule.zh: 通过 ID 添加、更新或关闭通知。悬停时暂停该条计时。

api.en: The queue holds 12 and shows 3 by default; hovering or focusing expands the stack and pauses its timers.
api.zh: 默认队列最多 12 条，展示 3 条；悬停或聚焦时展开并暂停计时。

motion.en: Notifications tuck behind the front toast and fan out with a spring; reduced motion changes immediately.
motion.zh: 通知堆叠在前方通知之后，以弹簧展开；减少动效时立即切换。

lead.en: Open a bottom panel with draggable snap heights.
lead.zh: 打开可拖动并停靠在不同高度的底部面板。

rule.en: Drag the handle or use its arrow keys, Home, End, Enter and Space. Escape closes the sheet.
rule.zh: 拖动把手，或使用方向键、Home、End、Enter 和空格调整高度；Esc 关闭。

api.en: Detents are fractions of the available height. The sheet emits open, close and snap events and returns focus on close.
api.zh: 停靠点是可用高度的比例；面板报告打开、关闭和停靠事件，关闭时归还焦点。

motion.en: The sheet follows touch, resists at the top and projects flick speed; reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 面板跟随触摸，在顶部提供阻尼，并根据甩动速度停靠；减少动效时立即更新。

lead.en: Navigate a short stack of related sheets.
lead.zh: 在多层相关面板中逐级导航。

rule.en: Open pages with push; pop returns one level and Escape closes the top layer.
rule.zh: 通过 push 打开下一层；pop 返回上一层，Esc 关闭最上层。

api.en: SheetStackChanged carries the currently open page IDs. Existing IDs return to that page.
api.zh: SheetStackChanged 返回当前打开的页面 ID；再次打开已有页面会返回对应层。

motion.en: The top panel follows dragging; background layers move with depth. Reduced motion removes depth movement.
motion.zh: 顶层面板跟随拖动，背景面板随层级移动；减少动效时去除层级位移。

lead.en: Browse product photos and select a color and size.
lead.zh: 浏览商品图片并选择颜色和尺码。

rule.en: Select thumbnails, a color and an available size; open the image viewer for a closer look.
rule.zh: 选择缩略图、颜色和可用尺码；打开图片查看器以放大查看。

api.en: Sizes can declare sold-out colors; changing color clears an unavailable size selection.
api.zh: 尺码可标记售罄颜色；更换颜色后如尺码不可用会清除选择。

motion.en: Photo changes crossfade and the magnifier follows the pointer; reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 切换图片时交叉淡入淡出，放大镜跟随指针；减少动效时立即更新。

lead.en: Browse square photo tiles at three densities, with favorites and an in-place viewer.
lead.zh: 按三档密度浏览方格照片，打开查看并收藏。

rule.en: Navigate with arrows, Page Up or Page Down. Press Enter to open. Swipe or scrub the filmstrip, then press Escape or pull down to return.
rule.zh: 方向键和翻页键可选择照片，按回车打开。滑动照片或拖动胶片条切换，按 Escape 或下拉返回。

api.en: Provide a stable ID, image source, alt text, title and intrinsic size. Defaults to three columns, with five and two also available.
api.zh: 提供稳定 ID、图片来源、替代文字、标题和原始尺寸。默认三列，也可切换五列或两列。

motion.en: Density changes preserve a visible anchor. The viewer grows from the selected photo and returns to the current cell.
motion.zh: 切换密度时保留可见照片锚点，查看器从选中的方格展开，关闭时回到当前照片。

lead.en: Browse a short photo collection on a perspective rail.
lead.zh: 在带景深的封面轨道中浏览照片。

rule.en: Drag or scroll sideways to browse. Click a neighboring cover or a tick. Press Left, Right, Home or End while the rail has focus.
rule.zh: 横向拖动或滚动可浏览，点按侧卡或位置点可切换。轨道聚焦后可用左右方向键、Home 或 End。

api.en: Items accept an image source, title, subtitle, meta and alt text. with_default_index starts at zero by default. with_index enables host control. with_caption accepts a typed item and index.
api.zh: 条目接收图片源、标题、副标题、附加信息和替代文字。with_default_index 默认为零，with_index 启用宿主控制，with_caption 可按类型化条目与索引渲染说明。

motion.en: Side covers turn and recede with image drift and a quiet reflection. A velocity spring lands the rail on a card. Reduced motion removes the turn, drift and spring.
motion.zh: 侧卡转向中心并后退，图片轻移并带柔和反射。松手按速度吸附。减少动效时省去转向、视差和弹簧。

lead.en: Browse integrations on two moving rings and open their connection details.
lead.zh: 在两圈旋转轨道中浏览集成，打开详情并连接。

rule.en: Filter by category. Use arrows, Home or End to browse, Enter or Space to open, and Escape to return focus.
rule.zh: 按类别筛选。方向键、Home 和 End 浏览，回车或空格打开，Esc 关闭并恢复焦点。

api.en: Use stable IDs and supply path data, an image source or a custom mark. Host-managed connections remain pending until the matching ticket settles.
api.zh: 提供稳定 ID，支持路径、图片或自定义标志。宿主管理的连接按对应请求编号返回成功或失败。

motion.en: The two rings turn every 64s and 88s at default speed. Selection parks the logo and expands the card. Reduced motion settles immediately.
motion.zh: 默认内外圈每 64 秒和 88 秒转一圈。选择时标志停靠并展开卡片；减少动态效果时立即就位。

lead.en: Voice orb with a host-controlled audio adapter.
lead.zh: 展示由宿主控制的语音会话状态。

rule.en: The host provides the device or audio playback adapter.
rule.zh: 控件不会自动申请麦克风；宿主负责会话和音量。

api.en: Subscribe to requests and provide actual state from the host.
api.zh: 订阅请求，由宿主提供实际状态。

motion.en: The visual follows state and respects reduced motion.
motion.zh: 视觉随状态变化，并遵循减少动效设置。

lead.en: Now playing with a host-controlled audio adapter.
lead.zh: 展开迷你播放器并请求播放或定位。

rule.en: The host provides the device or audio playback adapter.
rule.zh: 宿主负责播放音频，并提供当前曲目、进度和播放状态。

api.en: Subscribe to requests and provide actual state from the host.
api.zh: 订阅请求，由宿主提供实际状态。

motion.en: The visual follows state and respects reduced motion.
motion.zh: 视觉随状态变化，并遵循减少动效设置。

lead.en: Voice recorder with a host-controlled audio adapter.
lead.zh: 通过宿主适配器录制、回听并发送语音。

rule.en: The host provides the device or audio playback adapter.
rule.zh: 宿主负责麦克风、采集及保存；失败保留草稿，可重试。

api.en: On Start, Stop, Send or Retry capture request_id; use set_phase_for, set_error_for and append_message_for with that ID. Capture session_id for set_audio_for and set_recording_error_for. Message IDs deduplicate confirmations. Legacy unscoped methods remain available but the host must filter stale callbacks itself. On Retry inspect failed_operation to retry Start, Stop or Send. Waveform data keeps the most recent 1000 peaks; message playback follows stable IDs when the list changes.
api.zh: 收到 Start、Stop、Send 或 Retry 后捕获 request_id，通过 set_phase_for、set_error_for、append_message_for 返回结果；以 session_id 调用 set_audio_for 和 set_recording_error_for。消息 ID 可去重。旧的无编号方法保留兼容，但宿主必须自行过滤过期回调。 收到 Retry 时读取 failed_operation，分别重试启动、停止或发送。波形保留最近 1000 个采样点；消息列表变化时按稳定 ID 保持播放标记。

motion.en: The visual follows state and respects reduced motion.
motion.zh: 视觉随状态变化，并遵循减少动效设置。

lead.en: Request dictation and insert a recognized draft.
lead.zh: 发起听写并插入识别结果。

rule.en: The host owns microphone permission, recognition and editor insertion. A changed insertion point requires confirmation.
rule.zh: 麦克风授权、识别和插入由宿主负责；插入位置变化时先确认。

api.en: Capture session_id for recognition updates. On Insert capture insertion_id, then call confirm_insert_for or fail_insert_for with both IDs. A failed insertion retains the text and asks for the target again; the host must make insertion idempotent. Legacy unscoped methods require host-side stale-callback filtering.
api.zh: 识别更新使用 session_id。收到 Insert 后获取 insertion_id，再用两个编号调用 confirm_insert_for 或 fail_insert_for；插入失败保留文本并重新选择位置，宿主须保证插入幂等。旧无编号接口需宿主自行过滤过期回调。

motion.en: The control grows into a compact listening row; reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 控件展开为紧凑听写栏；减少动效时立即更新。

lead.en: Control host-provided speech with synchronized text.
lead.zh: 控制宿主提供的朗读音频并同步文字。

rule.en: The host performs synthesis and playback; the component sends requests and shows host-confirmed state. The progress track supports mouse, horizontal touch dragging and keyboard input; the host confirms the seek.
rule.zh: 宿主负责合成与播放；控件发出请求并展示宿主确认的状态。 进度条支持鼠标、横向触屏拖动及键盘操作；位置由宿主确认。

api.en: Capture session_id and operation_id on Start, Pause, Resume or Retry; apply asynchronous playback state using set_phase_for_operation. Stop ends the session. The host cancels synthesis or playback; unscoped and session-only methods require the host to filter stale operation results.
api.zh: 收到 Start、Pause、Resume 或 Retry 时捕获 session_id 和 operation_id，异步播放状态使用 set_phase_for_operation。Stop 结束会话；宿主仍需取消实际合成或播放。旧无编号及仅会话编号方法需要宿主自行过滤过期操作结果。

motion.en: The word highlight travels on a line and jumps between lines; reduced motion skips movement.
motion.zh: 高亮沿同一行滑动，跨行直接切换；减少动效时跳过移动。
